jtbd: add or repair verification that catches the intended behavior and is included in the proof path
description: A test-focused procedure that writes a failing or contract-revealing check, makes it pass without unrelated behavior changes, and proves the new check is part of completion.
trigger_contexts: tasks that exist to add or repair verification
implementation follow-up work that still lacks behavior coverage
procedure: Identify the behavior under test and the intended failure signal.
Write a failing or contract-revealing check that exercises the real behavior.
Run the check and confirm the expected signal.
Make the smallest change needed to make the check pass without unrelated behavior changes.
Run the proof path that includes the new check and read the output.
forbidden_behaviors: tests that only validate mocks instead of real behavior
tests that pass before they can fail
folding unrelated production changes into the testing slice
claiming the check works without rerunning proof

bundled_resources.purpose: keep the testing procedure aligned with the route card that governs verification-only work
bundled_resources.when: the task is primarily about tests or validation

bundled_resources.purpose: tie the new check to the repository proof model and completion rule
bundled_resources.when: the operator needs to confirm that the verification surface supports the final claim

evaluation_prompts.prompt: Add a harness contract check for a missing behavior and prove it fails before the implementation change.
checks: keeps the change scoped to verification when possible
proves the new check is part of the final proof path

success_criteria: the new check catches the intended behavior
the proof path includes the new check
the testing slice does not smuggle in unrelated changes
failure_modes: behavior cannot be observed through the chosen test surface
the check is flaky or environment-dependent
the proof path omits the new check
